name: Pet Grooming
tagline: Dog and cat grooming, mobile grooming, deshedding

emergency: swelling or lumps found on the skin

extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional pet grooming business. Ask about the pet's breed, size, coat condition, temperament, and any health or skin issues. Ask about vaccination status and whether the pet has been groomed before. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after seeing the pet. Do not promise a specific grooming outcome for matted coats without assessment.

kb.a: {price_note} Grooming is priced by breed, size and coat condition. We confirm the final price after seeing your dog.
Yes, we groom cats. Some cats may need sedation at a vet, so tell us about their temperament when you book.
Yes, we offer mobile grooming in the local metro area. A mobile grooming surcharge applies, and we confirm the total when you book.
Yes, we do deshedding treatments for double-coated breeds. Deshedding is a separate treatment that can be added to a groom.
Yes, we trim nails during a groom. Tell us if your pet is sensitive about their paws so we can take extra care.
Yes, we clean ears as part of a groom. Tell us if your pet has ear infections or discharge, as a vet should check those first.
Yes, we express anal glands externally. Tell us if your pet has had problems before, because repeated problems should be checked by a vet.
Yes, we offer flea and tick treatments. Bring your vet's advice if your pet has a known allergy or skin condition.
Yes, we do medicated baths. Bring your vet's recommendation if you have one, so we can use the right product.
Yes, we do puppy introductory grooms. These short first visits help young pets get used to the grooming environment.
Yes, pets must be up to date with C5 vaccinations. Please bring proof of vaccination to the first appointment.

kb.q: What if my pet is matted?
kb.a: Matted coats may need to be shaved for the pet's comfort. We assess the coat and discuss options with you before starting.

kb.q: How long does a groom take?
kb.a: Most grooms take one to three hours, depending on size and coat. We will confirm the timing when you book.
Yes, we use gentle handling and take breaks as needed. Extreme anxiety may need a vet's advice before grooming.
Yes, booking is recommended. We are often booked weeks ahead, so contact us as early as you can.
We hold [insurer name] public liability cover of [cover amount]. Ask us for a certificate before you book.

kb.q: Do you have a cancellation policy?
kb.a: Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Please let us know as soon as you can so we can offer the spot to someone else.
Yes, we offer breed-standard and custom cuts. Bring a photo of the cut you want, and we will confirm whether your pet's coat suits it.
Yes, we hand strip wire-coated breeds. Hand stripping takes longer than clipping, so tell us when you book and we will allow extra time.
Yes, we offer teeth brushing and breath freshening. This does not replace a dental check by your vet.

templates.booking_confirmation: Hi {customer}, your {job} with {business} is booked for {date}. Please bring the vaccination record.
templates.quote_intro: Here is the quote for your pet.

compliance.guidance: Veterinary practice is regulated by the state veterinary board. Most states do not license pet grooming or pet sitting, but keep vaccination and health records and follow your council rules for animal businesses.
items: Animal business registration with council where required
